This texture is only the flat walkable ground; collision architecture is rendered separately. Keep all stone and metal forms flush, softly lit by even underground ambient light. Beautiful deliberate brushwork, credible material detail, entirely original design. Square opaque image.
qa: Visually inspected original dark mine-floor material; seamless repetition must still be checked in actual renderer. No collision obstacles encoded in texture.
